description: BDTOPO® Réseau routier - Toponyme Communication - Calvados is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by BUREAU DE RECHERCHES GÉOLOGIQUES ET MINIÈRES. The TOPO® BD version 2.2 contains a 3D vector description (structured into objects) of the elements of the territory and its infrastructures, of metric precision. It is delivered pre-symbolized in the most common proprietary formats on the market. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "BDTOPO® Road network - Toponyme Communication - Calvados" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include transport. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
